Trace, implement and test: Rectangle

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class Rectangle extends Shape {
    private double length;
    private double width;

    public double getLength() {
        return length;
    }

    public void setLength(double length) {
        this.length = length;
    }

    public double getWidth() {
        return width;
    }

    public void setWidth(double width) {
        this.width = width;
    }

    @Override
    public double area() {
        return length * width;
    }

    @Override
    public double volume() {
        return -1;
    }
}
